name: Breeze Canna x 5 Infused Bangers | Grape
description: The Breeze full flavor, full effect in a preroll. Relish the classic, juicy taste of ripe grapes that never goes out of style. Enhanced with limonene, myrcene, and linalool terpenes, this beloved flavor brings uplifting, creative, and relaxed effects that make it perfect for any time of day.
